name: job-search-skill-library
description: Evidence-based job search skills for role analysis, applications, and interviews.

interface.longDescription: A compact set of reusable skills for evaluating job descriptions, assessing evidence-based fit, selecting roles, optimizing applications, preparing for interviews, and identifying career skill gaps. Uses a shared source-of-truth evidence foundation and does not invent candidate claims.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the Job Search Skill Library to evaluate this role and guide my next steps using verified evidence.
